messages:
Jamie (Sales): Heads-up: enterprise trial customer reports 401 -> they said "invalid credentials: project missing" when calling embeddings. Using a service account key we minted for their trial. Need quick help before next week's exec demo.
Leah (SE): Do we have the request details? Is this hosted or Dedicated?
Jamie (Sales): They're on a Dedicated POC in us-east, tenant id = tnt_42. Their sample request: 
```
curl -X POST https://dedicated.us-east.api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sa_poc_987' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"embed-lite-v1","input":"test"}'
```
Returns 401 with JSON: `\{"error\":\"invalid credentials: project missing or not bound\"}`
Tomas (Infra): If it's Dedicated, SA keys must be bound to the tenant/project on provisioning. Looks like this key was created without binding. Also check that their request includes `x-redwood-tenant` header for routing.
Leah (SE): Agreed. For Dedicated we require either: - bound SA key OR - user (sk_) token tied to tenant context + tenant header. Ask them to try: `-H 'x-redwood-tenant: tnt_42'`.
Nina (Security): They also asked about the key creation audit trail for the security questionnaire. We keep creation logs and can provide a CSV of key events (created, bound, rotated) for the POC. For Private deployments we support KMS integration.
Jamie (Sales): Customer sent back headers they used; no tenant header present. They said portal shows the key id sa_poc_987 but project_id = null.
Tomas (Infra): Infra log: `edge-req=ghk-21 status=401 code=project_unbound key=sa_poc_987 region=us-east`
Tomas (Infra): Two fixes: 1) re-provision the SA key with tenant binding + scopes `embeddings.generate,inference.execute`; or 2) if they prefer, switch to short-lived user token: have the user log into our portal and exchange for sk_tmp -> that will inherit tenant context.
Leah (SE): For immediate unblock I'll create a temporary bound key with minimal scopes and an expiry of 7 days for the demo. I'll mark it as for POC and attach to tenant tnt_42. Note: we never paste secrets in Slack; I'll put secret in 1Password and share with the customer contact only.
Jamie (Sales): Perfect. Can you also include the curl sample they can run after we issue the key?
Leah (SE): Yes, example for them to run once they have the secret: 
```
curl -v -X POST https://dedicated.us-east.api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sa_poc_bound' \
  -H 'x-redwood-tenant: tnt_42' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"embed-lite-v1","input":"hello world"}'
```
Should return 200 + vector array. If they still see 401/403, ask them to paste the response headers and full body.
Nina (Security): For the questionnaire answer: key lifetimes are configurable; recommend issuing short-lived keys for demos. We support role-based scopes (least privilege) and provide audit logs (we can provide redacted logs for compliance). I'll draft a concise paragraph they can include in the questionnaire.
Tomas (Infra): Also FYI: if they hit rate limits after switching keys, send timestamps and `edge-req-id` from response headers and we'll correlate with rate-limiter shards.
Jamie (Sales): Great. Leah, proceed with the temporary bound key and ping when done. Nina please attach the security blurb. I'll follow up with the customer and confirm they run the curl.
Leah (SE): Creating now, will update ticket with key id (not secret) and 1Password link to secret.
InfraBot: event: key_provisioned id=sa_poc_bound tenant=tnt_42 scopes=[embeddings.generate] created_by=leah.se expiry=2026-04-05T12:00:00Z
Jamie (Sales): Thanks team — customer demo scheduled next Wednesday, will confirm once they validate.
Leah (SE): If anything else pops up, tag me and I'll jump in.
